videos.desc: A couple on a couch films themselves playing a word game: a letter B pops up on screen, they think hard, pull faces and race to shout words that start with B, cheering and celebrating after each answer.
videos.said: We play a word game. Say a word fast. Barber. Bowling!

videos.desc: A woman spreads a deck of white cards into a fan on the table, asks a question, and draws one card as her answer; it reads 'You have to wait' and she stares at the camera in annoyed disbelief.
videos.said: I ask a question. The card gives me my answer. Really? Again?

videos.desc: A man at an outdoor chess table frowns at the board, strokes his chin, taps his temple and even stands up and paces while his amused opponent waits. At last the idea comes, he makes his move and both players react excitedly.
videos.said: Wait, wait, almost... There it is!

videos.desc: At dusk a woman in a denim jacket stands at a lit bus-stop panel showing a giant cheeseburger, her mouth open and her hand on the glass as if she could eat it. From a car window a billboard slides past against an orange sunset, showing a big white house with palm trees and a pool. Then at night she stands alone in Times Square with her arms out, looking up at a stack of glowing screens advertising burgers and perfume.

In a bright flat a woman stares hard at a wooden shelf that has just been screwed to the white wall, her brow furrowed and her mouth twisted in disbelief. Behind her a man holding a screwdriver smiles and gestures at his work. She raises a white mug, edges it slowly onto the shelf and lets go, watching to see if it holds. The shelf holds the mug; she steps back, folds her arms and looks at it sideways, still unconvinced.

A young man with wild hair and glasses stands at a huge blackboard in a university lecture hall full of students. He writes chalk equations fast, checks a pocket calculator, keeps writing, punches the air, and by the end the entire wall-sized blackboard is filled with mathematics while he stands back in front of it.

A young man in glasses with headphones round his neck sits at a desk holding small word cards. He taps his temple, reads a card, flips it over and drops it, and the cards multiply until the desk is buried and the wall behind him is papered with them.

At a busy outdoor market a woman in a headwrap holds up two apples, one in each hand, then puts them on the two pans of a brass balance to see which she wants. She does the same with two melons, then two sacks on a market scale, and finally two huge pumpkins on a wooden beam that tips to one side.
videos.said: Hmm, this one or this one?

videos.desc: In an office a woman sticks a green sticky note onto a square of a huge wall calendar, then sits and writes in a colour-tabbed planner. She adds more notes to the calendar, and the wall grows into an enormous grid covered with hundreds of coloured notes while she stands with her hands on her hips looking up at it.

A woman in a leather cap and khaki jacket sits at a table set with small bowls of food, holding a clipboard and a pen. She stamps rows of stars onto small white cards with a rubber stamp and holds one up, wide-eyed. The table fills with dozens of cards each showing five stars, some black and some gold. The final wide shot reveals the table and the whole wall behind her covered with hundreds of identical five-star cards.

A tide of commuters in grey and navy suits with briefcases crosses a street between glass office towers; in the middle of them walks one young woman in a bright turquoise coat, red beret, yellow headphones and yellow boots, the only colour in the crowd. She perches on a concrete bollard while the suits stream past behind her, sips an orange juice and smiles into the camera.

In a wood-panelled courtroom a man in a grey suit heaves armfuls of heavy leather-bound volumes onto the bench beside a set of brass scales and a gavel, and the pile keeps growing. A close shot shows one thick book lying open on the stack, its pages dense with tiny print, with rows of seated people behind it. In the last shot the stack has become a tower taller than the people, the judge sits beside it and the whole room stands staring.

In a library aisle a young woman in glasses builds an investigation board on a cork wall: she pins up notes and photographs, links them with red string, gasps as something clicks, flips through a sheaf of papers with a pen in her mouth, and steps back to look at the finished web of pinned pages, printed photos and sticky notes. Bookshelves, a laptop and stacks of books and papers surround her.

A woman in a striped top stands in a hallway with a small teal hard-shell cabin case, pulling its handle up, then heaves a much bigger navy soft suitcase down next to it and gestures at the two. The shot cuts to an airport hall where she is pushing a trolley loaded with six stacked suitcases in different colours, leaning into it with a strained face while the top case tips off the pile.

A black-and-white montage of five people puzzling over something they want to figure out: a young woman in a kitchen holds a pen against her chin and stares upward with a frown; a man at a chess board in a library hovers his hand over a piece; a teenager in a hoodie presses a hand over his eyes; a student in a jumper bites her pen over an open notebook; finally a young woman at a kitchen table gasps with delight and starts writing on her papers.
